mood: Moody and relentless: a courier train thundering through a violet night with amber headlamps.

shape.borderStyle: 1px solid #FF63C9 at 40% opacity; amber rail line under the active item
shape.texture: thin horizontal rail-sleeper lines in perspective

motifs: city skyline with a big moon
buttonStyle: Primary is an amber-filled button with plum text and a small spark glyph on hover; secondary is a plum button with a pink hairline outline.
backdrop: Violet gradient sky with a pale moon and city skyline; two amber rails converge to the horizon and the sleepers slide slowly toward the viewer (background-position).
motion: Gentle, slow drifts only; nothing flashes or pulses faster than once per second (WCAG 2.3.1), and all ambient motion stops when the user picks reduced motion.
